title: iris variabilis subsp. sordida
intro: Iris variabilis subsp. sordida, commonly known as the Yellow Iris or Yellow Flag, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is said to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Iris variabilis subsp. sordida include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
